Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies

Crisp edges, chewy centers, and plenty of chocolate.

  • Prep: 15 minutes
  • Cook: 12 minutes
  • Total: 30 minutes
  • Yield: 24 (1 cookie)
  • 4.5 / 5

Ingredients

  • 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1 cup butter, softened
  • 2 cups chocolate chips

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 375°F (190°C).
  2. Cream butter and sugars, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
  3. Stir in flour mixture and chocolate chips. Scoop onto a sheet.
  4. Bake 9–12 minutes until golden. Cool on the pan for 2 minutes.

Nutrition

  • Calories 180 kcal
  • Protein 2 g
  • Fat 9 g
  • Carbs 24 g
